title: Language hot switching
line: Changing the language in System Settings now switches the panel and its popups to the new language right away, without logging out.
explanation: The display language (LANGUAGE in plasma-localerc) was only read by startplasma at login, and the Region & Language page saved it without notifying anyone, so a running Plasma kept the old language until the next login. Since KF6, ki18n reloads its languages on QEvent::LanguageChange and KLocalizedQmlContext retranslates every QML engine, but nothing in Plasma triggered that. The page now saves the language entry with KConfig's notify flag (Notifiers=language), and plasmashell watches plasma-localerc: on a change it sets LANGUAGE in its own environment and in the systemd/D-Bus activation environment (KUpdateLaunchEnvironmentJob), then sends LanguageChange so all QML text is retranslated live. Anything that writes the key with kwriteconfig6 --notify (an installer, for example) gets the same result.

commits.message:
shell: apply a new display language without logging out

Changing the language only took effect at the next login, so the panel
and its popups stayed in the old language. Plasma now follows the saved
language right away and newly started apps inherit it.

BUG: 500914

media.caption: Pure master: switch Language to Deutsch in Region & Language and Apply; the network popup and Kickoff stay in English
Same steps with the fix: right after Apply the network popup and Kickoff show German text
Network popup after applying Deutsch on master: Connected / Available / Connect / Search, all English
With the fix: Verbunden / Verfügbar / Verbinden / Verbindung trennen / Suchen, no logout
Kickoff after applying Deutsch on master: all English
With the fix: QML text switches (Suchen, Anwendungen, Orte, Sitzung); strings built in C++ models (Favorites, categories, Restart, Shut Down) stay English until the next login
